market_summary.text: Monday before the open. The strategy lab re-tested every rule: only the US stock momentum rule passes (test-period yearly return +36.6% vs +18.5% buy-and-hold, worst drop -42.4%); every crypto rule now fails, including the trend rule behind our Bitcoin and Ether trades. Economic data (FRED): US 10-year yield 5.1% (Oct 15), oil (WTI) $101.91 (Oct 14), Fed funds 3.75%, unemployment 4.2% (September); Bank of Canada says USD/CAD is 1.4154. Chip stocks fell hard on Friday: AMD dropped about 6% as every stock in the chip index fell, so I vetoed the AMD buy. XLE passed the news check but its price is from Friday, too old for the risk engine, so it will be tried after the open. AAPL, JNJ and XOM orders fill at the 9:30 open.
